fishing: WHEN: Thu Oct 22 post-front improving. PASSES-BEACH: still limited by recent wind/king tides; some redfish near passes on live shrimp/pilchards. LEMON BAY: hit-or-miss back bay redfish, small snook, snappers around mangroves/docks/oyster bars. NEARSHORE: few windows due to weather, mangrove snapper when possible on reefs. Baits: live shrimp, pilchards, soft plastics, gold spoons.
redtide: FWC Oct 16: K. brevis at background concentrations in 6 samples from/offshore SWFL (Sarasota in/offshore, Hillsborough offshore). Not present Charlotte/Lee/Collier. No fish kills or respiratory irritation past week.
bacteria: Englewood Beach GOOD ~10 CFU/100mL (DOH Charlotte Healthy Beaches, sample ~Oct 5-7). No advisory. Manasota Key similar good.
fpl: Charlotte ~2 outages, Sarasota ~149 outages (recent trackers); small isolated only, no major Englewood/Manasota impact.
